# langsmith_tag_value (Resource)

Manages a value belonging to a workspace-scoped LangSmith resource-tag key. Import with `<tag_key_id>/<tag_value_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_tag_key" "environment" {
  key = "Environment"
}

resource "langsmith_tag_value" "production" {
  tag_key_id = langsmith_tag_key.environment.id
  value      = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_key_id` (String) Parent tag key ID.
- `value` (String) Tag value, unique within its key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional tag value description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Tag value ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
